### 🤖 AI Intelligence Summary
> **Executive Summary:**  ACME Solar Holdings Limited is undertaking an amalgamation scheme to merge three of its direct and indirect wholly-owned solar power subsidiaries (ACME Pokhran Solar, ACME Sikar Solar, and ACME Eco Clean Energy) into the parent company. This consolidation aims to simplify the corporate structure and streamline operations. A key financial detail is that two of the three merging subsidiaries (ACME Pokhran Solar and ACME Eco Clean Energy) are currently operating at a net loss, which will now be integrated directly into ACME Solar Holdings Limited's financials.

Announcement under Regulation 30 of Securities and 
Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulation, 2015 – Scheme of Amalgamation 
amongst ACME Pokhran Solar Private Limited, ACME Sikar 
Solar Private Limited, ACME Eco Clean Energy Private Limited 
and ACME Solar Holdings Limited and their respective 
shareholders and creditors 
 
Dear Sir/ Madam,  
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the Securities and Exchange 
Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 
2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”), we hereby notify the stock exchanges that 
the board of directors of the Company in their meeting held on September 18, 
2026, has considered and approved a Scheme of Amalgamation involving 
amalgamation of ACME Pokhran Solar Private Limited, ACME Sikar Solar Private 
Limited and ACME Eco Clean Energy Private Limited (direct or indirect wholly 
owned subsidiaries of ACME Solar Holdings Limited ) with and into ACME Solar 
Holdings Limited (“Scheme”), in terms of the provisions of Sections 230–232 
and other applicable provisions, if any, of the Companies Act, 2013.  
 
The details as required under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations read 
with SEBI Master Circular HO/49/14/14(7)2025-CFD-POD2/I/3762/2026 dated 
January 30, 2026, are set out in Annexure A enclosed herewith.  
 
The aforementioned meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company 
commenced at 6:52 P.M. (IST) and concluded at 7:09 P.M. (IST).  
 
A copy of this intimation is being hosted on the website of the Company at 
www.acmesolar.in
